text:
Lina Park: Hi all — first day laptop (MacBook Air M3) stuck on 'Applying profile' during enrollment, shows 'Waiting for DEP assignment'. Been on company Wi-Fi and ethernet, tried reboot. Need to finish so I can install Docker/Homebrew. Any quick wins or temp admin?

Mike IT: welcome! can you DM me the serial? I'll check ABM/DEP. also, did you hit any captive portal on the network?

Lina Park: sent SERIAL CN12345ABC in DM. No captive portal. Wi‑Fi is 'redwood-sec' and I accepted the company cert when prompted.

kandji-bot: DEP assignment check for serial CN12345ABC: status=assigned_to_other_org; last_polled=60s ago.

Mike IT: looks like ABM shows it bound to another org. i'm asking ABM team to reassign. if that doesn't move we'll grant a one-time admin for 24h. hold tight.

Samir: FYI you can run these to surface profile/jamf state, if comfortable: 
```
sudo profiles -N -L
sudo jamf checkJSSConnection
```

Lina Park: ran `sudo profiles -N -L` — got: "Profile installation failed: manifest mismatch".

Mike IT: ok that matches ABM issue. Priya — can we approve a temp admin for onboarding? Lina is in batch-3 hires.

Priya: approved. @Mike IT please create a one-time admin with 24h expiry and log it in the onboarding ticket.

Mike IT: created temp admin account `lina-temp`. Password sent via shared 1Password note. Expires in 24h. Use it to install Rosetta, Docker, Homebrew.

Lina Park: thanks! quick Q — need Rosetta for some Intel deps. on M3 — will that work? sudo prompts sometimes blocked by MDM.

Zane: For Rosetta run: `softwareupdate --install-rosetta --agree-to-license` using the temp admin. If MDM blocks GUI prompts, the CLI path usually succeeds.

Lina Park: Rosetta installed successfully. Docker initially failed with a hyperkit/kext error: "kernel extension blocked by system policy".

Samir: On newer macOS Docker Desktop uses the virtualization framework; try the M1-specific build from our internal artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood/internal/docker-m1-variant.dmg — reinstall and reboot.

Lina Park: reinstalled from the dmg, Docker now starts. Kandji is still showing "recovery key: not reported" for disk encryption.

kandji-bot: Recovery key escrow pending for serial CN12345ABC. Escrow requires successful MDM profile install; flagged for manual escrow by IT.

Mike IT: I'll trigger a manual escrow and confirm. Lina, once Kandji shows escrow OK we'll revoke the temp admin. thanks for your patience :thumbsup:

Lina Park: amazing, thanks everyone! one small thing — any onboarding checklist or docs I should follow first-week? :)

Priya: welcome again! onboarding checklist is here: https://wiki.redwood/in/onboarding/new-engineer — ping me directly if anything else comes up.

Mike IT: marking ticket #ONB-482 as resolved after escrow completes, will update.

Lina Park: noted, thanks all.
